# The Second Chapter {#sec-second}

<!-- TODO: TEMPLATE CONTENT. Replace this chapter with the author's text. -->

A figure is an image plus a caption, an anchor, and alt text for readers
who can't see it (required to sell ebooks into the EU):

```markdown
![Caption under the figure.](../figures/my-figure.png){#fig-mine fig-alt="What the figure shows, in one sentence."}
```

Refer to it as `@fig-mine`. Use PNG or PDF images for books; SVG needs an
extra converter for the print PDF. Math is written in LaTeX notation, inline
as $E = mc^2$ or displayed:

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$ {#eq-sum}

@eq-sum is numbered and linked in every format.
